study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative Modeling of Brain Morphometry in Clinical High Risk for Psychosis

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ENIGMA Clinical High Risk for Psychosis Working Group pooled sample (29 international sites); CentileBrain reference sample pooled from 81 datasets.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "...pooled from 29 international sites participating in the Enhancing Neuroimaging Genetics Through Meta-analysis (ENIGMA) Clinical High Risk for Psychosis Working Group."; "...37,407 healthy individuals (53.3% female) with an age range of 3-90 years pooled from 81 datasets."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Haas2024.pdf.md: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS; yoi230077supp1_prod_1703694733.69427.pdf.md: eMethods / Normative Modeling Using FreeSurfer-Derived Regional Brain Morphometric Measures

answer.ENIGMA: case-control study sample (CHR-P and healthy individuals) for applying normative model and testing deviations

answer.MULTI-DATASET (UNSPECIFIED OR N>=10): normative model training/testing reference sample (CentileBrain; sex-specific 80% train/20% test)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ENIGMA CHR-P sample provides CHR-P and healthy participants for deviation analyses; CentileBrain pooled 81-dataset reference sample used to train/test sex-specific normative models with 80/20 split.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "...regional measures of cortical thickness (CT), cortical surface area (SA), and subcortical volume (SV) from 1340 individuals with CHR-P and 1237 healthy individuals pooled from 29 international sites..."; "Sex-specific subsamples of each pooled sample were randomly split into a training subset (80%) and a test subset (20%) stratified by scanning site."
